mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO problem_tag ( value, label_en, label_zh, active, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{row.value}, #{row.labelEn}, #{row.labelZh}, TRUE, NOW(), NOW() )
ON CONFLICT (value) DO UPDATE SET label_en = EXCLUDED.label_en, label_zh = EXCLUDED.label_zh, active = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ( problem_tag.label_en, problem_tag.label_zh, problem_tag.active ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.label_en, EXCLUDED.label_zh, TRUE )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM problem_tag_assignment assignment USING problem p WHERE assignment.problem_id = p.id AND p.slug = #{problemSlug}
mapper.select: SELECT p.slug FROM problem p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT array_agg(pt.value::TEXT ORDER BY assignment.ordinal) AS tag_values, array_agg(pt.label_en::TEXT ORDER BY assignment.ordinal) AS tag_labels_en, array_agg(pt.label_zh::TEXT ORDER BY assignment.ordinal) AS tag_labels_zh FROM problem_tag_assignment assignment JOIN problem_tag pt ON pt.id = assignment.tag_id WHERE assignment.problem_id = p.id ) normalized_tags ON TRUE WHERE p.tag_values IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE( normalized_tags.tag_values, ARRAY[]::TEXT[] ) OR p.tag_labels_en IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE( normalized_tags.tag_labels_en, ARRAY[]::TEXT[] ) OR p.tag_labels_zh IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE( normalized_tags.tag_labels_zh, ARRAY[]::TEXT[] ) ORDER BY p.slug ASC

SELECT p.slug FROM problem p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS assignment_count, MIN(assignment.ordinal) AS first_ordinal, MAX(assignment.ordinal) AS last_ordinal FROM problem_tag_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.problem_id = p.id ) assignment_stats ON TRUE WHERE cardinality(p.tag_values) != assignment_stats.assignment_count OR ( assignment_stats.assignment_count > 0 AND ( assignment_stats.first_ordinal != 0 OR assignment_stats.last_ordinal != assignment_stats.assignment_count - 1 ) ) ORDER BY p.slug ASC

SELECT CONCAT(assignment.problem_id::TEXT, ':', assignment.tag_id::TEXT) FROM problem_tag_assignment assignment LEFT JOIN problem p ON p.id = assignment.problem_id LEFT JOIN problem_tag pt ON pt.id = assignment.tag_id WHERE p.id IS NULL OR pt.id IS NULL ORDER BY assignment.problem_id ASC, assignment.tag_id ASC
SELECT value FROM problem_tag GROUP BY value HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY value ASC

SELECT pt.id AS tag_id, pt.value, pt.label_en, pt.label_zh FROM problem_tag_assignment assignment JOIN problem p ON p.id = assignment.problem_id JOIN problem_tag pt ON pt.id = assignment.tag_id WHERE p.slug = #{problemSlug} ORDER BY assignment.ordinal ASC
